modules.behavior: Sixteen-tap symmetric FIR filter on a signed 16-bit valid/ready sample stream with round-half-up scaling, saturation and a five-slot elastic pipeline. Coefficients h[0..15] = -6, -20, -24, 18, 110, 226, 330, 390, 390, 330, 226, 110, 18, -24, -20, -6: h[k] = h[15-k], eight unique signed values that each fit 10-bit two's complement, total 2048. Let x[n] be the n-th accepted in_sample (two's complement) since reset, with x[m] = 0 for every position before the first sample accepted after reset. For each accepted sample compute the exact integer acc = sum over k = 0..15 of h[k] * x[n-k]; the pre-adder form sum over k = 0..7 of h[k] * (x[n-k] + x[n-15+k]) is equivalent, and each pairwise sum needs 17 bits. |acc| <= 73662464, so 28 signed bits hold it exactly. Then r = floor((acc + 1024) / 2048) (add 1024, arithmetic shift right by 11: round half up) and out_sample = 32767 if r > 32767, -32768 if r < -32768, else r (saturate, never wrap). Only accepted samples enter the history; invalid or blocked cycles never change it. Handshake: five elastic slots with valid bits v1..v5, all 0 after reset; out_valid = v5 and out_sample is the result held in slot 5. ready5 = !v5 || out_ready, ready_i = !v_i || ready_(i+1) for i = 4, 3, 2, 1, and in_ready = ready1: a combinational function of out_ready and the registered valid bits only, with no path from in_valid, in_sample or rst. At a rising edge with rst low, every slot i whose ready_i is 1 takes the valid bit and result of slot i-1, where slot 0 is the input (valid = in_valid; the sample is accepted when in_valid && in_ready); a slot whose ready_i is 0 holds. So a sample accepted at edge k reaches slot 5 after edge k+4 at the earliest and can transfer at edge k+5 (minimum accepted-transfer age 5, exact when out_ready stays high); the pipeline sustains one sample per cycle; bubbles collapse, so in_ready is 0 only when all five slots are full and out_ready is 0. While out_valid && !out_ready, out_valid and out_sample stay stable. out_sample is unspecified while out_valid = 0. Synchronous active-high rst at a rising edge empties every slot, clears the history to zero and overrides acceptance; reset has no effect between edges (an off-edge rst pulse changes nothing). Producers hold in_sample and in_valid while blocked. For the Python scoreboard oracle ONLY: each non-reset step is one accepted sample; keep the previous 15 accepted samples in state (zeros after reset), read in_sample as signed 16-bit, compute acc, r and the saturated result, and return out_sample masked to 16 bits. A supplied rst clears the history and returns out_sample 0; init() is the reset state. Do not model the slots, readiness or backpressure in the oracle. Each example starts from reset and after_cycles repeats the same accepted sample: 1000 once gives acc = -6000 and out_sample -3 (65533); 32767 thirteen times gives acc = 32767 * 2098 and saturates to 32767; -32768 eight times gives acc = -32768 * 1024 and r = -16384 (49152).

implementation.meaning: Out-of-context implementation (chip_top_flow_for_soc_block): the top is a block inside a larger design, synthesized with synth_design -mode out_of_context and placed and routed without I/O buffers or package pins. clk is constrained at the target period and modeled as driven by a global clock buffer (HD.CLK_SRC). Data ports have no input or output delay and no pad delay, so they are unconstrained I/O; the routed WNS and WHS, and timing acceptance, cover the internal clocked paths only, and combinational logic between a port and its first or last register is not timed. Utilization excludes I/O buffers.

metric_provenance: Structured metrics are parsed from retained reports; routed utilization/timing reports take precedence when present. The manifest identifies complete files by hash. Header excerpts are bounded previews, not complete reports or an independent metric source.
objective_policy: First establish timing feasibility. A verified timing-feasible candidate may replace a known timing-infeasible previous best even with higher area or power; classify this as timing_recovery, not objective savings. While the previous best is timing-infeasible, a verified still-infeasible candidate with strictly better setup WNS and hold not worse beyond a small tolerance may replace it as timing_progress, which is not closure; a feasible candidate always outranks it. Once both are timing-feasible, require strict improvement of the chosen objective; for maximize_freq that is register-to-register setup slack (reg2reg_wns_ns) when both designs report it, otherwise full setup WNS for both, while feasibility stays on full WNS and WHS. minimize_luts compares (lut_used, ff_used) and minimize_ffs compares (ff_used, lut_used) lexicographically: an equal primary metric with a strictly lower secondary is an objective improvement, a higher primary never is, and a secondary missing from either design gives no tie-break. Unknown or contradictory incumbent timing evidence cannot establish recovery. A completed experiment may find no improvement. Do not invent mandatory savings, slack margins, tool versions, timing corners, new tests, thresholds, code-style quotas or external environment requirements.
